messages:
Maria Gomez: Putting PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5234 on merge-hold for today's release. Fixes routing fallback + touches KV cache. Requesting independent sign-offs — shadow approvers OK if primary reviewers are offline.

Kevin Liu: Ack. I can take a pass in ~30m. Any quick smoke steps?

Maria Gomez: Smoke steps: `make test-smoke` then `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` and check logs for KV cache NPEs. CI shows one flaky timing test; I'm pushing a micro-fix shortly.

Samir Patel: I'm OOO until 15:00 PT but can do a quick run and shadow-approve after that if needed :+1:. Prefer to avoid blocking the window if smoke & canary look OK.

Kei Tanaka: Reviewing now. Tiny nit in `router.go` around the cache access (line ~142) — should guard against empty `cache.kv`. Can push a one-line null-check if you want.

Maria Gomez: Please do, Kei — pushed `fix/null-check` branch and updated the PR. Thanks.

Kevin Liu: Ran the smoke locally, KV logs look stable, canary in eu-west shows no regressions. Left a small logging suggestion but not blocking.

Kei Tanaka: LGTM (shadow) — left a comment and approved.

Samir Patel: +1 (shadow). Approving now after quick smoke.

deploy-bot: Heads-up — release window closes at 16:00 PT. Merge hold will be auto-released at cutoff unless the PR has a `block-release` label.

Maria Gomez: Marking PR with `merge-on-green` and `shadow-approved`. Will merge once CI finishes and there are no regressions.

Kevin Liu: Leaving final LGTM now. Go ahead once CI is green.

Maria Gomez: Merged after green CI — thanks everyone for the quick checks :tada:
